_comment: Default equal weighting (VARIABLES_AND_DATA_SOURCES.md SS4). First thing to hand back to domain reviewers to retune -- see workflow.md SS5/SS10 step 7. Weights are normalized to sum to 1 at load time, so relative values matter, not absolute ones.

stress_test_elasticities._comment: How much each sub-index moves per unit of (footfall_multiplier - 1). workflow.md SS6: water/waste scale ~linearly with visitor count, worker income share is structurally fixed short-run, infrastructure adequacy erodes (fixed capacity, more visitors per toilet/parking spot), socio-cultural pressure and visitor experience move with crowding. Tunable, documented, not a black box.
